arxiv-2106-00481.title: Dark matter in a charged variant of the Scotogenic model
arxiv-2106-00481.creator: Valentina De Romeri
arxiv-2106-00481.description: Abstract Scotogenic models are among the most popular possibilities to link dark matter and neutrino masses. In this work we discuss a variant of the Scotogenic model that includes charged fermions and a doublet with hypercharge 3 / 2 3/2 . Neutrino masses are induced at the one-loop level thanks to the states belonging to the dark sector.

arxiv-2201-06164.title: Synthesis and Reconstruction of Fingerprints using Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2201-06164.creator: Rafael Bouzaglo, Yosi Keller
arxiv-2201-06164.description: Abstract Deep learning-based models have been shown to improve the accuracy of fingerprint recognition. While these algorithms show exceptional performance, they require large-scale fingerprint datasets for training and evaluation. In this work, we propose a novel fingerprint synthesis and reconstruction framework based on the StyleGan2 architecture, to address the privacy issues related to the acquisition of such large-scale datasets.

arxiv-2304-05217.title: Field configurable skyrmion devices utilising fine planar motion control
arxiv-2304-05217.creator: Charles Kind
arxiv-2304-05217.description: Abstract Magnetic skyrmions are nano-scale spin textures whose stability, size and ease of manipulation make them strong contenders for next generation data and logic applications. Here we illustrate fine motion control of skyrmions, we show how they can be moved in any direction and for any distance, in the plane.

arxiv-2402-15288.description: Abstract In this work, we present a high-throughput FPGA ( FPGA ) demonstrator of an ANN ( ANN )-based equalizer. The equalization is performed and illustrated in real-time for a 30 GBd, PAM2 ( PAM2 ) optical communication system. arxiv-2505-03090.title: The ISAC systems aided by MIMO, RIS and with Beamforming Techniques
arxiv-2505-03090.creator: Rafael Augusto Pedriali, Isadora Martines Ferreira, Jose Carlos Marinello, Taufik Abrão
arxiv-2505-03090.description: Abstract This paper explores the integration of communication and sensing in modern wireless systems through the configuration of BS and RIS antenna elements. By leveraging time multiplexing for both communication and sensing, the proposed system optimizes spectral efficiency and operational performance.

arxiv-2506-23455.title: General Signal Model and Capacity Limit for Rydberg Quantum Information System
arxiv-2506-23455.creator: Jieao Zhu, Student Member, IEEE and Linglong Dai, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2506-23455.description: Abstract Rydberg atomic receivers represent a transformative approach to achieving high-sensitivity, broadband, and miniaturized radio frequency (RF) reception. However, existing static signal models for Rydberg atomic receivers rely on the steady-state assumption of atomic quantum states, which cannot fully describe the signal reception process of dynamic signals.

arxiv-2507-16014.title: Byzantine-Resilient Distributed Computation via Task Replication and Local Computations
arxiv-2507-16014.creator: Aayush Rajesh, Nikhil Karamchandani, Vinod M. Prabhakaran
arxiv-2507-16014.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aayush Rajesh, Nikhil Karamchandani, Vinod M. Prabhakaran. We study a distributed computation problem in the presence of Byzantine workers where a central node wishes to solve a task that is divided into independent sub-tasks, each of which needs to be solved correctly. The distributed computation is achieved by allocating the sub-task computation across workers with replication, as well as solving a small number of sub-tasks locally, which we wish to minimize due to it being expensive.

pmc-10528551.title: Lipid Profile Variations in Pregnancies with and without Cardiovascular Risk: Consequences for Both Mother and Newborn
pmc-10528551.creator: Simona-Alina Abu-Awwad, Marius Craina, Lioara Boscu, Elena Bernad, Paula Diana Ciordas, Catalin Marian, Mircea Iurciuc, Ahmed Abu-Awwad, Stela Iurciuc, Brenda Bernad, Diana Maria Anastasiu Popov, Anca Laura Maghiari, Luminita Paduraru, Simona Vladareanu
pmc-10528551.description: Background: Maternal cardiovascular risk and its implications can have significant repercussions for both the mother and the child. This study compares the lipid profiles of two distinct groups of pregnant women, those with and without cardiovascular risk, to shed light on its effects on maternal and outcomes for newborns.

pmc-12561925.title: Eph receptor tyrosine kinases are functional entry receptors for murine gammaherpesvirus 68
pmc-12561925.creator: Anna K. Großkopf, Victor Tobiasson, Laurie T. Krug, Robert Kalejta, Robert Kalejta, Robert Kalejta
pmc-12561925.description: Interactions between viral glycoproteins and cellular receptors determine virus tropism and represent promising targets for vaccines. Eph receptor tyrosine kinases are conserved receptors for the human oncogenic gammaherpesviruses, Kaposi sarcoma herpesvirus (KSHV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), and mediate entry into target cells by interaction with the viral gH/gL glycoprotein complex.

pmc-12562883.title: Dissecting Melanoma Ecosystem Heterogeneity from Molecular Characteristics to Genetic Variation at Single-Cell Resolution
pmc-12562883.creator: Congxue Hu, Liyuan Li, Tengyue Li, Baobin Qi, Wanqi Mi, He Yu, Kaiyue Yang, Qi Ou, Xia Li, Yunpeng Zhang
pmc-12562883.description: Melanoma shows heterogeneity across body sites like skin, acral skin, and the uvea, driven by molecular characteristics and genetic variations. However, comparative studies exploring the heterogeneity of melanoma across different anatomical sites remain limited, hindering a comprehensive understanding of its underlying biology.

pmc-12930664.title: Association of migraine with subsequent risk of depression or anxiety by small-area deprivation: national cohort study with sibling analysis
pmc-12930664.creator: Emily White Johansson, Mattias Linde, Anna Ohlis, Mathias Mattsson, Ahmed Nabil Shaaban, Sofie Gustafsson, Johan Holm, Christina Dalman, Emilie E. Agardh
pmc-12930664.description: BackgroundGrowing evidence indicates that migraine could increase the risk of depression or anxiety in affected persons. Residential deprivation, with its links to stressful environments and access to quality services, could exacerbate the risk of developing depression or anxiety among migraine patients, but evidence remains limited.

pmc-12986342.title: Characterizing the Clinical, Vascular, and Functional Phenotype of Metabolic Acidosis in Kidney Transplantation: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12986342.creator: Lucian Siriteanu, Adrian Covic, Cezar Băluță, Călin Namolovan, Simona Mihaela Hogaș, Irina Draga Căruntu, Luminița Voroneanu
pmc-12986342.description: Introduction: Metabolic acidosis is common after kidney transplantation and is associated with adverse outcomes. However, its vascular and functional correlates in kidney transplant recipients remain insufficiently characterized. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of adult kidney transplant recipients attending routine outpatient visits at a tertiary transplant center. Metabolic acidosis was defined as serum bicarbonate < 22 mmol/L.

pmc-13168826.title: Measuring what matters: Modern evaluation practices in clinical and translational science
pmc-13168826.creator: Boris Volkov, Valerie Harder, Brenda Joly

pmc-13402829.title: B-site modulation tailors the size distribution of ex-solved nanoparticles for optimized active sites in perovskites
pmc-13402829.creator: Jun Kyu Kim, Su Keun Kuk, Sungwoo Kang, Jong-Min Lee, Hyuk Jae Kwon
pmc-13402829.description: Supported nanoparticles fabricated by an ex-solution process from perovskite scaffolds serve promising capabilities for various thermal and electrochemical reactions. Although the size distribution of the nanoparticles plays a crucial role in catalysis, it remains difficult to control in ex-solution due to the lack of understanding of their underlying energetic factors.

pmc-13470477.creator: Jing Dai, Kwan-Nyeong Kim, Guangzhong Xie, Dong-Su Choi, Seung-Woo Lee, Eojin Yoon, Chan-Yul Park, Han Dai, Somin Kim, Hyun-Haeng Lee, Tae-Woo Lee
